message.reasoning: Customer says: "Our last invoice still lists the old office. Can you correct it and resend?" They want to correct invoice details and resend. According to policy: Meridian does not reissue invoices that have already been generated. A correction applies to invoices from that point forward only. So cannot resend. They can request a corrected copy of past invoice for own records. So we must answer: cannot reissue, but can provide a corrected copy via support. So we answer accordingly. Use policy.
